messages:
maria_finance: Heads-up — during EOM reconciliation we found a mismatch for ACME (acct ac-01234). Dashboard shows 1,242,300 tokens for March, invoice (INV-2025-AC-999) charged 1,251,720 tokens. +9,420 tokens landed on invoice only and pushed them over the Standard tier threshold, so the billed plan tier and line items differ. Can billing / data triage?

josh_billing: Thanks Maria. Can you paste the invoice line items (snippet) and the dashboard export you used? Also need the invoice generation timestamp.

maria_finance: Invoice id INV-2025-AC-999, generated 2025-04-01T00:05:12Z. Line items (redacted):
```
- usage: embeddings - 512k units - $X
- usage: tokens - 1,251,720 - $Y
- plan: Standard monthly prorate
```
Dashboard CSV attached (summarized): tokens=1,242,300, embeddings=0. Customer says they didn't embed at volume.

priya_support: Customer contacted CSM earlier, said they saw no spike in app metrics. They pasted a stacktrace from their side showing a flurry of 500s around 2025-03-31 23:57-23:59 UTC and retried. Sample request ids they provided: r_8c3a1, r_8c3a1-retry1, r_8c3b2. They insist retries shouldn't count double and dashboard shows nothing matching that magnitude.

alan_data: Quick dump from our ledger and raw events. Two suspicious things: 1) the billing ledger ingestion job ingests events by ingestion_timestamp (time we processed the event) while the dashboard engine uses event_timestamp (original API timestamp). If ingestion lag or backfills occur across the month boundary we can move tokens onto the invoice month but not the dashboard export. 2) retries are creating new request_ids in some SDK versions so dedupe by request_id fails.

alan_data: SQL excerpt — the current ledger rollup uses:
```
SELECT sum(tokens) FROM billing_events
WHERE ingestion_timestamp >= '2025-03-31' AND ingestion_timestamp < '2025-04-01';
```
We should be using event_timestamp for month grouping and dedupe on (client_request_id, event_hash) not the generated request_id.

eve_eng: +1 to Alan. Also saw a KV-cache backfill job (job id kb-2025-03-31-backfill) that wrote token-attribution into ledger after midnight UTC due to retries on a subset of embeddings. That backfill uses ingestion time for ledger and doesn't update dashboard cache. So the invoice saw the tokens, dashboard didn't.

ledger-bot: automated entry: backfill job kb-2025-03-31-backfill completed 2025-04-01T00:45:03Z; rows inserted: 3,210; total_tokens: 9,420.

priya_support: From CS — customer provided SDK version: 1.4.2, which we know created new request_ids for retries (we flagged this in 1.4.3). They retried on 500 errors. So likely double-count from retries + backfill.

josh_billing: Ok that explains the delta amount matching the backfill. But we need an immediate remediation for the customer (they're upset about tier bump). Proposal: issue credit for the 9,420 tokens and adjust tier proration, then run a full audit to confirm no other accounts affected. Any objections?

eve_eng: Agreed. Long term fix items: 1) change ledger rollup to use event_timestamp for month cutoffs, 2) update dedupe logic to use stable client_request_id when present and a hash of payload as fallback, 3) prevent backfill jobs from using ingestion_timestamp for month attribution (or annotate and hold until safe window). I can open a PR tonight for (1) and (2).

alan_data: I'll prepare a query to find all accounts with backfill rows crossing month boundaries in the last 6 months and share a list. Quick query:
```
SELECT account_id, SUM(tokens) as leaked_tokens
FROM billing_events
WHERE source = 'backfill' AND date_trunc('month', ingestion_timestamp) != date_trunc('month', event_timestamp)
GROUP BY account_id
HAVING SUM(tokens) > 1000;
```

sarah_csm: I'll draft the customer message offering a one-time credit and explanation. Needs finance signoff.

josh_billing: Finance ok to credit once we have the audit list and confirmed amount for ACME. Proceed with credit for INV-2025-AC-999: credit tokens = 9,420, mark invoice as adjusted and send revised invoice. Priya/Sarah, please coordinate communication.

maria_finance: Thanks all — action items consolidated: 
- eve_eng: PR for ledger/event_timestamp + dedupe (ETA 24h)
- alan_data: audit query + impacted accounts list (ETA 4h)
- josh_billing: prepare credit & adjusted invoice for ACME (after audit)
- sarah_csm/priya_support: customer comms draft (ETA 2h)
- platform_ops: add guardrail to backfill jobs to set backfill_flag and not affect month cutoffs (follow-up).

eve_eng: also note follow-up: we should patch SDK release notes and reach out to customers on 1.4.2 to rotate client_request_id behaviour.

priya_support: ack. I'll update the support ticket with interim explanation and ETA.

sarah_csm: tagging customer for a 09:00 PST call tomorrow.

josh_billing: I'll post the credit transaction id when done. :thumbsup:

maria_finance: Closing loop — please update this thread as items land. Major thanks — good catch by the reconciliation script. :pray:
